title: Check an installed front brake pad through the wheel
instruction: Measure the outer brake pad through the wheel, return both gauges, and mark the measured thickness range on the inspection card.
context: Automotive service technicians inspect disc brake friction linings during routine service. Toyota specifies measurement with a ruler or pad thickness gauge, and ASE A5 covers disc brake inspection and service. BLS counted 825,800 automotive service technicians and mechanic jobs in 2025 across all duties. This task isolates the restricted inspection through a mounted wheel, with both pads and the caliper retained. The marker records the measured range on the bench inspection card.
setup: A fixed 2007-era Camry ACV40 right-front donor corner on a bench stand includes the hub, mounted 16-inch seven-spoke wheel and tire, 296 mm Brembo 09.A417.11 rotor, carrier, closed floating caliper and two P83117N pads. The nominal outboard lining is 9.00 mm. Stock Lisle 81920 and 81930 gauges start in separate rests. Use the README's three-point measured specimen qualification for a physical reset. The 8 mm gauge is identified in blue and the 10 mm gauge in orange. A yellow marker begins in the START box of the 161 × 202 mm inspection card.
scoring: 0.25 after the 8 mm gauge goes through a spoke opening and the measuring head touches the rotor within the gap. 0.50 once it also touches the underside of the backing. 0.75 when the 10 mm head goes through a spoke opening, rests on the rotor and physically stops against the backing edge. 1.0 after returning both gauges and releasing the marker within 8 mm of the 8–10 mm box center, with the grippers clear and the result settled for one second.
fidelity: Rigid collision geometry represents both pads, caliper, carrier, hub, wheel barrel, seven spokes and tire. Exterior sizes follow published components. Cast profiles, spoke offsets and the offset gauge head profiles are estimates. The hub stays fixed and the dust shield, brake actuation and acetal flex are omitted. A measured physical specimen and through-wheel fit check are pending. Gauge colors distinguish sizes on camera. The card represents a bench inspection record.
scores: Dream-1, seed 0, 0.00 in 1,800 controls. Scripted demo, seed 0, 1.0 in 1,106 controls.
reset_notes: Use a specifically marked used P83117N outboard specimen with three 8.90–9.10 mm lining-only readings at the accessible end. Record the readings and specimen photo, then confirm the two stock heads through the installed wheel.
